I'll compute the sum of the decimal digits of 48^11 to verify the result.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Calculate 48^11
result = 48 ** 11
print(f"48^11 = {result}")

# Calculate sum of decimal digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(result))
print(f"Sum of decimal digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
